22884.new_name: Embroidered Mesh Bodysuit in Five Sizes
22884.title_note: ladies/onesies 弱词剥；mesh embroidery→Embroidered Mesh；S-XXL 五码属实
22884.desc:
Embroidery on mesh is craft applied to almost nothing: the ground fabric is transparent, so every stitch sits on air, and the pattern has to hold its own without a backing to lean on. This bodysuit runs the technique across a sheer mesh jumpsuit body — embroidered detailing over see-through ground — and the result is a piece that reads as needlework first and as sheer second.

The sizing is the category's most generous arrangement: five sizes from S to XXL, covering 85–170 lbs, because embroidered mesh has limits to its stretch and the size run respects them. At five grades the embroidery lands where it was stitched on every body in the range, which is the entire argument for grading rather than stretching.

The color follows the listing photos. As a one-piece it is complete on its own; as a layer it does things under a blazer that a plain bodysuit cannot.

Quick specs:

  • Fabric: Sheer mesh with embroidery
  • Style: One-piece bodysuit
  • Colors: As pictured
  • Sizes: S (85–105 lbs / 39–48 kg), M (105–120 lbs / 48–54 kg), L (120–140 lbs / 54–64 kg), XL (140–155 lbs / 64–70 kg), XXL (155–170 lbs / 70–77 kg)

Craft on air, sized for every body it fits.
22884.short: Embroidered sheer mesh bodysuit in five sizes from S to XXL for 85–170 lbs, embroidery on transparent ground, colors as pictured.

22921.title_note: Dream 弱词剥；white+sheer 参数回填；costume→set（保守）
22921.desc:
White sheer mesh is the genre's morning register: where black mesh reads as evening, white reads as the day after — or the day of, depending on ambition. This set runs the color across sheer mesh with nothing else competing: one transparent idea, in the one color that makes transparency look accidental rather than engineered.

The cut follows the sheer: simple lines, no panels, no contrast trim, the mesh doing all of the designing through its own visibility. As sleepwear it is light enough to forget; as lingerie it is the least aggressive possible version of total transparency.

The size runs in pounds — one size for 85–130 lbs — and the mesh stretch honors the band. The cold wash is the entire care regimen, and the set packs to the size of a pocket handkerchief.

Fast facts:

  • Fabric: Sheer mesh
  • Style: Lingerie set
  • Color: White
  • Fit: One size, 85–130 lbs (39–59 kg)

Total transparency, minimum aggression.

22932.new_name: Cinched-Waist Lace Teddy in Two Colors
22932.title_note: one-piece vest→teddy；lace cinched waist 参数上标题；双色属实；85-135lbs
22932.desc:
A cinched waist on a lace teddy is the difference between a sack and a silhouette: the gathering at the middle gives the fabric a shape to hold, and the eye a line to follow. This teddy is built around that gathering — lace with a defined waist, in a one-piece cut that pulls on and stays put.

The lace runs a steady pattern with the cinch as its focal point, and the fit runs generous in the category's usual pound notation — one size for 85–135 lbs — with the gathering absorbing much of the range on its own. Black and white versions split the registers as they always do.

As a layer under a shirt the cinched waist keeps the teddy from bunching, which is the practical case for the design beyond its looks. As lingerie it is a complete one-piece with one strong line.

The rundown:

  • Fabric: Lace, cinched waist
  • Style: One-piece teddy
  • Colors: Black, white
  • Fit: One size, 85–135 lbs (39–61 kg)

One line through the middle, and the fabric organizes itself.

22933.title_note: seduction 堆词剥；Midnight 保留（风格词）；S/M/L 真实围度（三围全列）展开
22933.desc:
Openwork in black is the nighttime version of the pattern: the holes are there in daylight too, but after dark they do their real work, which is to let the lighting design the outfit. This jumpsuit commits to the register — full openwork knit in black, fitted through the body — and lets the pattern carry everything.

The measurements are unusually complete: S runs a 72–86 cm bust and 60–66 cm waist, M a 76–90 cm bust and 64–70 cm waist, and L an 80–94 cm bust and 68–74 cm waist, each with its weight band from 40 to 65 kg. In openwork those numbers matter more than in solid knit — the pattern only sits right under tension, and the sizing is what provides it.

As a one-piece it is complete; as a base layer under a jacket it is the category's most useful trick. Either way, the openwork is the entire design and needs no help.

Quick specs:

  • Fabric: Openwork knit
  • Style: Fitted one-piece jumpsuit
  • Color: Black
  • Sizes: S (bust 72–86 cm, waist 60–66 cm, 40–50 kg), M (bust 76–90 cm, waist 64–70 cm, 50–60 kg), L (bust 80–94 cm, waist 68–74 cm, 60–65 kg)

22959.title_note: inner（内搭直译）剥；silver 参数上标题；S/M/L 磅制三码
22959.desc:
Silver on a bodysuit is a color with an agenda: it reads as metal, it photographs as light, and it makes the wearer the brightest object in any room that is not actually on fire. This piece spends the color on a cut-out design — openings distributed across a fitted metallic-look base — sized in three honest grades.

The cut-outs are the structure of the design, each one a placed decision about where the silver stops. On a light-reflecting base they do double duty: the fabric catches the room, and the holes release it. Three sizes by weight band — S for 85–105 lbs, M for 105–120, L for 120–140 — keep the openings where the pattern intended.

As clubwear it is self-explanatory; as lingerie it is the category's disco installment. Either way the piece is complete at the color choice, and everything else follows.

  • Style: Cut-out bodysuit
  • Color: Silver
  • Sizes: S (85–105 lbs / 39–48 kg), M (105–120 lbs / 48–54 kg), L (120–140 lbs / 54–64 kg)

22960.new_name: Bow-Accent Mesh Bodysuit in Two Colors
22960.title_note: sexy butt showing 直译剥；bow 参数上标题；S-XL 四码+红黑双色
22960.desc:
A bow accent on a bodysuit is design's smallest signature: it adds nothing structural and changes the entire read, the way a well-placed signature changes a letter. This piece signs itself with a bow at the bodysuit's focal point, over a sheer mesh base, in the two colors that sign things loudest.

The mesh runs see-through with the bow placed where the eye lands first, and the bodysuit beneath is a fitted one-piece with the usual four grades: S, M, L and XL by weight band, from 85 to 140 lbs. Red and black versions split festive and classic — the red leaning into the bow's gift connotations, the black subverting them.

As a layer the piece works under anything sheer enough to show it; on its own it is a complete design with one gesture at its center. The cold wash keeps both the mesh and the bow's shape.

The specifics:

  • Fabric: Sheer mesh with bow accent
  • Style: Fitted bodysuit
  • Colors: Red, black
  • Sizes: S (85–105 lbs / 39–48 kg), M (105–120 lbs / 48–54 kg), L (120–140 lbs / 54–64 kg), XL (140–155 lbs / 64–70 kg)

One signature gesture, placed where signatures go.

22997.new_name: Deep-V Stretch Bodysuit in Three Colors
22997.title_note: one-piece skirt→bodysuit（参数 bodysuit 为准）；high elasticity→Stretch；三色三码属实
22997.desc:
A deep-V on a high-stretch bodysuit is a neckline that behaves: the fabric's recovery keeps the V where it was cut instead of letting it travel, which is the failure mode of the style on lesser knits. This piece makes the neckline its one design commitment — a deep-V front on a stretch polyester bodysuit, in three colors and three grades.

The stretch is the product's other half: high-elasticity knit that maps the body and returns to shape, wash after wash. Three sizes by weight band — S, M and L, from 85 to 140 lbs — and three colors: gray, white and black, which run understated, bridal-adjacent, and default respectively.

As a base layer it disappears under anything except its own neckline; on its own it is a one-piece that needs no second piece and no explanation. The care is a cold wash and a flat dry.

Quick specs:

  • Fabric: High-stretch polyester
  • Style: Deep-V bodysuit
  • Colors: Gray, white, black
  • Sizes: S (85–105 lbs / 39–48 kg), M (105–120 lbs / 48–54 kg), L (120–140 lbs / 54–64 kg)

One neckline, held where it was cut.
